$description: Haulcast design tokens. Generated by .planning/design/scripts/build_tokens.py, do not hand-edit (edit the script).

dev.haulcast.spec: W3C Design Tokens Community Group, Format Module 2025.10 (https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format/)
dev.haulcast.modeConvention: $value is the LIGHT value. $extensions['dev.haulcast'].modes.dark holds the DARK value (alias or literal). Tokens without it are mode-independent.
dev.haulcast.cssNaming: CSS custom property = '--' + kebab-joined path with the tier segment mapped: primitive -> 'p', semantic -> dropped, component -> 'c'. semantic.color.text.primary -> --color-text-primary; primitive.color.red.700 -> --p-color-red-700; component.button.primary-bg -> --c-button-primary-bg. Underscores never appear (risk level no_travel is spelled no-travel in token paths).
dev.haulcast.shadowAlpha: Shadow layers carry '$alpha' (0-1) applied to the shadow colour; tokens.css renders it with color-mix(). Dark mode doubles shadow alpha.
dev.haulcast.nonStandardType: map.basemap.style-url uses $type 'string-url' (not a DTCG type); consumers read it from tokens.resolved.json.

ink.$description: Shadow base colour (tinted ink, never pure black).

overpass.$description: Overpass (OFL-1.1, Delve Fonts / Red Hat), a libre interpretation of the FHWA Highway Gothic road-sign alphabets. @fontsource-variable/overpass, latin subset, wght 100-900.

overpass-mono.$description: Overpass Mono (OFL-1.1). @fontsource-variable/overpass-mono, latin subset, wght 300-700. Monospaced = tabular by construction.

map-glyphs.$description: MapLibre symbol-layer fontstack served by OpenFreeMap glyphs (Noto Sans Regular/Bold/Italic only). Only for text drawn INSIDE the map canvas.

raised.$description: Cards, popovers, menus, toasts (separated by border + shadow, not by tint).

sunken.$description: Inset wells: segmented-control track, code/kbd, skeleton base.

selected.$description: Selected list row / table row / segmented item background.

disabled.$description: Disabled text (WCAG-exempt; never carries required information).

on-ink.$description: Text/icons on ink-filled controls (primary button, selected plate).

danger.$description: Validation errors, error states (light shares the Severe ink: both mean stop; dark is one step lighter for 4.5:1 on pressed surfaces).

success.$description: Success text (e.g. link copied). Darker than the Low fill so it holds 4.5:1 on tinted surfaces.

default.$description: The accent. Haulcast's only interface accent is ink: primary actions, selection, focus.

hover.$description: Danger button hover fill (its resting fill is text.danger). Moves as ink does: toward the page on hover, past the resting fill on press (R1-30).

hairline.$description: Decorative rules and dividers (no contrast requirement).

control.$description: Input, select, checkbox, segmented outlines (>= 3:1 vs every surface).

strong.$description: Selected card / plate / active outline (= ink).

halo.$description: Outer halo that keeps the ring visible on the map canvas and on ink fills.

no-safe-route-bg.$description: Do-not-depart banner: solid No Travel ink with on-fill text.

info-bg.$description: Info = neutral ink, no hue (colour is reserved for risk).

scenario-hatch.$description: Diagonal hatch ink for the simulated-weather stripe.

fill.$description: Low: risk fill (ribbon, marker, badge, bar segment, heatmap cell).

on-fill.$description: Text/icon/pattern ink drawn ON the fill.

stroke.$description: Marker outline / ribbon casing that separates the fill from the basemap.

fill.$description: Moderate: risk fill (ribbon, marker, badge, bar segment, heatmap cell).

on-fill.$description: Text/icon/pattern ink drawn ON the fill.

stroke.$description: Marker outline / ribbon casing that separates the fill from the basemap.

fill.$description: High: risk fill (ribbon, marker, badge, bar segment, heatmap cell).

on-fill.$description: Text/icon/pattern ink drawn ON the fill.

stroke.$description: Marker outline / ribbon casing that separates the fill from the basemap.

fill.$description: Severe: risk fill (ribbon, marker, badge, bar segment, heatmap cell).

on-fill.$description: Text/icon/pattern ink drawn ON the fill.

stroke.$description: Marker outline / ribbon casing that separates the fill from the basemap.

fill.$description: No Travel: risk fill (ribbon, marker, badge, bar segment, heatmap cell).

on-fill.$description: Text/icon/pattern ink drawn ON the fill.

stroke.$description: Marker outline / ribbon casing that separates the fill from the basemap.

fill.$description: Unknown (missing data): neutral grey, dashed, never green.

pattern-alpha.$description: Opacity of the on-fill ink when drawn as a pattern over a risk fill (legend, stacked bar, profile chart).

opacity.$description: fill-opacity for wind/rain/snow field cells (roads + labels draw above the field).

risk-opacity-low.$description: fill-opacity for Low cells in the risk field (quiet: Low is 'cleared', not 'nothing').

risk-opacity.$description: fill-opacity for Moderate..No Travel and Unknown cells in the risk field.

wind.$description: mph. Wind below this is not tinted (still Low risk).

rain.$description: in/hr. Rain below this is not tinted.

snow.$description: in/hr. Snow below this is not tinted.

land.$description: Basemap background as shipped (positron: background-color rgb(242,243,240); dark: rgb(12,12,12)). Reference only, not overridden.

label-override.$description: Override text-color of water_name_* labels (light) / all place + road name labels (dark).

motorway-casing-override.$description: highway_motorway_casing line-color (light) so interstates read under the field.

motorway-inner-override.$description: highway_motorway_inner line-color (light keeps white; dark lifts the shipped #000 roads to mid-grey so they read over field cells).

casing.$description: Casing under every risk ribbon (separates risk colour from basemap + field).

outline-selected.$description: Outer outline of the SELECTED route only (= ink).

unknown-dash.$description: Ribbon colour for Unknown segments (drawn dashed).

fill.$description: Origin/destination pins, route plates (selected), truck markers (selected).

text.$description: Our own map-canvas text (checkpoint ETA labels).

title-lg.$description: Page H1 on mobile; recommendation headline on desktop.

caption.$description: Attribution, footnotes, legend notes (12 px is the floor).

overline.$description: UPPERCASE instrument labels (KeyValue/Stat/table headers only, never section eyebrows).

data.$description: Readouts: ETA, slider value, popover values.

control.$description: Inputs, buttons, badges, chips, segmented items, kbd (road-sign plate corner).

container.$description: Cards, popovers, menus, toasts, banners, dialogs.

sheet.$description: Top corners of the mobile bottom sheet only.

round.$description: Switch track/thumb, slider thumb, origin pin, risk 'low' circle. Nothing else.

indicator.$description: Active tab underline, selected route-card left rule.

raised.$description: Cards on the map (legend, timeline dock). Dark mode: border carries elevation; shadow alpha x2.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls (plus not-allowed cursor; text uses text.disabled).

skeleton-static.$description: Skeleton under reduced motion: a static level instead of the pulse (R1-11).

base.$description: Popover/tooltip in, tab indicator, chip toggle.

frame.$description: Timeline playback: one forecast hour per 250 ms (4 frames/s). A cadence, not an animation: reduced motion keeps it (R1-16).

skeleton.$description: Skeleton opacity pulse period (static under reduced motion).

tooltip-delay.$description: Hover delay before a tooltip opens (focus opens immediately). An interval, not an animation: reduced motion keeps it.

spinner.$description: Spinner rotation period (linear, infinite; no animation at all under reduced motion) (R1-11).

sheet-peek.$description: Bottom sheet collapsed height (handle + one summary line), plus safe-area inset.

sheet-half.$description: Bottom sheet half snap = 50% of the dynamic viewport height.

sheet-full-gap.$description: Bottom sheet full snap leaves this much map visible at the top (= header height).

map-inset.$description: Gap between map edge and floating map UI (legend, timeline, zoom).

auto-column-min.$description: Narrowest column of an auto-fill Grid (minmax(220px, 1fr), section 10) (R1-11).

target-min.$description: WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target. Every pointer target >= this.

target-touch.$description: Comfortable touch target on < 1024 px (buttons, chips, segmented items, sheet handle).

press-offset.$description: A pressed control sinks by this much, with its pressed colour (section 10, generic states) (R1-11).

halo-width.$description: Halo drawn outside the ring (box-shadow) on map overlays and ink fills.

track-padding.$description: Gap between the track's edge and the thumb; thumb travel = track width - 2 x padding - thumb size.

scale-days-height.$description: Timeline: strip above the track holding the weekday label and the midnight rule (R1-11).

scale-days-overlap.$description: Timeline: the midnight rules run this far down into the track band.

scale-ticks-height.$description: Timeline: strip below the track holding the hour ticks and the +6 h labels.

scale-tick-length.$description: Timeline: hour tick (1 px x 6 px).

scale-tick-length-major.$description: Timeline: every sixth hour (10 px tick with a +6 h label).

scale-tick-label-y.$description: Timeline: baseline of the +6 h labels, from the top of the tick strip.

scale-day-label-y.$description: Timeline: baseline of the weekday label, from the top of the day strip.

scale-day-rule-top.$description: Timeline: a midnight rule starts here and ends at the bottom of the day strip.

rule-width.$description: Left rule next to the 1 px border (section 10, Banner).

icon-nudge.$description: Optical alignment of the 20 px icon with the first line of text.

content-min.$description: Text never gets narrower than this: below it the action wraps instead of squeezing the text.

nav-min-width.$description: Component-level threshold (D-29): the header shows its navigation from this CONTENT width (a 360 px phone minus 2 x 12 px of padding). A container query cannot read a token, so a test pins the literal in the CSS to this value.

toggle-min-width.$description: Component-level threshold (D-29): from this header content width (a 380 px phone minus 2 x 12 px) the theme toggle's items are 44 px wide; narrower, 40 px, so the header fits 360 px.

drift.$description: Enter: a drift from the trigger side, with opacity.

padding-block.$description: Padding 6 x 8 (section 10, Tooltip); the horizontal padding is space.2.

offset.$description: Gap between trigger and tooltip (section 10, Tooltip).

grip-width.$description: Section 10, BottomSheet: the handle's grip bar is 36 x 4 px (D-29).

max-height.$description: Tallest an option list (ComboBox, Select) grows before it scrolls. Section 10 gives no height: a design gap, closest to the 320 px popover width (D-29).

sort-icon-size.$description: Section 10, Table: the sort arrow on the sorted column is 12 px (D-29).

outline-extra.$description: Selected outline width = casing width + this.

unknown-dasharray.$description: line-dasharray [1.4, 1.1] in line-width units for Unknown segments.

label-min-zoom.$description: Checkpoint ETA labels appear at zoom >= 8.

selected-scale.$description: icon-size multiplier for the active (hovered/focused/popover-open) checkpoint.
